name: Minato Business Hotel
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for an independent business hotel near a station: linen-white ground, stone panels and ink text with one warm charcoal band and a single suo rose accent, Cormorant over Jost. The home page opens on a full-height, high-key photograph of a quiet double room at first light with the headline on a paper card, then an arrival strip (check-in from two, breakfast from six, four minutes from the station), one night at the hotel as a masonry of seven timed photographs, the four rooms as cards with their specifications, the walk from the station with walking minutes, an essay on long stays and company accounts, three guests' words, the journal and a plain closing to book direct. With Rooms & rates, Your stay, People, Breakfast, Business stays, About, Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The hotel details are one synced pattern, edited once. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
